other_exits: N Bars border timeout exit: closes position after N bars if neither SL nor TP hit, triggering martingale lot increase on next entry

position_sizing.conditional_logic: After a loss (SL hit or N-bars border close), lot size is multiplied by martingale factor; after a win (TP hit), lot resets to base value. Lot size also checked against available margin.

custom_logic_notes: N Bars Borders logic: EA tracks number of bars since entry. If position is open for N bars without hitting SL or TP, it is closed at market (border exit). This loss triggers martingale lot multiplication on the next VIDYA signal entry. After a TP hit, the martingale resets to base lot. VIDYA direction change can also close and reverse positions. Digit adjustment applied to SL/TP pip values when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001.
python_conversion_notes: Martingale sizing with margin checks requires accurate margin simulation; N-bars border exit requires bar counting from entry; VIDYA is available as ta library variable index dynamic average or can be computed from CMO + EMA; digit adjustment logic must be replicated for multi-decimal symbols; margin-dependent lot sizing is broker-specific and hard to replicate accurately in Python backtesting; recommend using vectorized bar-level backtest with tick data for realistic fill simulation
